output: On the login page, click Forgot Password, type your registered email, and use the reset link we send to your inbox.
The library opens at 8 AM and closes at 8 PM on weekdays; on Saturdays it is open 9 AM to 2 PM.
Fill the bonafide request form at the administrative office and bring your ID card. It takes three working days.
Pay the semester fee through the student portal before the 15th of the first month of the semester.
Send an email from your college account to your mentor, or attend the weekly mentor hour on the timetable.
Results appear in the Results section of the student portal once they are declared.
Complete the membership form on the club notice board or website, then attend the next orientation.
Mid-semester hostel rooms depend on availability, so apply to the warden and give a valid reason.
Open the scholarship section of the student portal, complete the application, and submit it with the required documents before the deadline.
Sign in to the student portal, open Profile, edit your contact details, and save the changes.
Register for courses via the student portal by selecting courses, checking prerequisites, and submitting before the deadline.
Access online library resources by logging into the library portal with your student credentials to find e-books, journals, and databases.
The computer lab is open from 9 AM to 6 PM. Log in with your ID, follow lab rules, and do not install unauthorized software.
Submit a leave of absence request form to the academic office with a valid reason and supporting documents. Approval from the head of department is needed.
Find the academic calendar on the college website under Academics. It lists important semester dates, exams, and holidays.
Report technical issues by submitting a ticket through the IT support section on the student portal or email the IT helpdesk with details.
Request a transcript through the student portal or contact the registrar's office. Provide necessary details and pay any fees.
To join the annual cultural fest, register on the event portal, attend orientation, and follow participation guidelines.
Submit assignments via the student portal before deadlines. Ensure they are in the required format and include all necessary components.
View your class schedule by logging into the student portal and going to the Schedule section for course names, timings, and locations.
